events.description: “Komatsu licensing deal confirms blue-chip commercial credibility,” with the investment-case slide stating that “Komatsu [is] signed.”
“Further global laser cell opportunities, with discussions underway for additional cells in new markets.”
A modular laser cell for Komatsu was completed on time and on budget and passed factory acceptance in June 2026, with site operation to commence in Q1 FY27.

The Komatsu licensing agreement reached a key milestone with the first modular laser cell passing factory acceptance in June 2026 and commissioning completed, with site operation to begin in Australia in Q1 FY27.
Further laser cell projects progressed through development, with additional contracts expected in FY27 and discussions underway on cells in other regions.
“The Komatsu licensing agreement, valued at $2.4 million, provides independent validation of this technology from a blue-chip global customer.”
“Commissioning of the cell has since been completed, with site operation to commence in Australia during Q1 FY27.”
